board: SparkFun GPS Breakout - NEO-M9N, U.FL (Qwiic), GPS-15712 (top 7-pin header GND, 5V, 3V3, CS, RX/MOSI, TX/MISO, SCK)
reason: Modelled as a 38400-baud NMEA uart-device (datasheet default interface settings) with a talker-agnostic, checksum-verifying GGA/RMC driver; pin order taken from SparkFun's Eagle board file and dimension drawing.
